# CrabCraft Modpack

A modpack with all the recommended mods to run when playing on CrabCraft. These are mainly QoL  focused mods - with some crabcraft related tweaks!

Mods listed in bold are highly recommended.

Currently includes:
- **AppleSkin**
- **Armor Poser**
- Axiom
- Chat Heads
- Cloth Config
- EntityCulling
- Fabric API
- Forge Config API Port
- **ImageFrame Client**
- Iris
- **Jade**
- Lithium
- Mod Menu
- No Chat Restrictions
- Reese's Sodium Options
- Remove Reloading Screen
- **Simple Voice Chat**
- **Sodium**
- Sodium Extra
- **Voxy**
- **Xaero's Minimap**
- **Xaero's World Map**

# 🚨 Vulkan Support
At the moment, this modpack only supports OpenGL. Vulkan support is dependant on the [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) mod supporting it. If you want to run Vulkan, you'll need to remove or disable [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) for the time being.

# FAQs
**What is the main focus of this modpack?**
This modpack is intended to improve the player experience when joining servers utilising the mods listed above.

**Will the modpack be updated to support the latest versions?**
Yes, we will be updating the modpack to support the latest versions as soon as possible. We may need to wait a few days for the mod authors to update their mods.
